_comment: Real AI-visibility / GEO monitoring tools, names only (verified to exist via 2026 comparison articles, 2026-11-19). Short forms on purpose: matching is whole-word, so 'Peec' also matches 'Peec AI' and 'Otterly' matches 'Otterly.AI'. Profound is left out: 'profound' is an ordinary English word and would cause false matches.
